fixed_inputs: All day-reference RF, station positions, weather, antenna calibration and baseline admitted reference paths; no refiltering by final-product elevation.
evaluation: Same four models and chronological split. Compare zero and shared-satellite RMS, per-station gains and centered residual differences. Transfer rapid-trained shared offsets to final test rows as a labelled diagnostic, without refitting to test outcomes.
stopping_rule: Acquire these five files once; retain acquisition or compatibility failure, no substitute provider, date, stations, clock version or sample selection in this version.
scope: Same-provider rapid/final paired-product sensitivity, not independent truth or causal identification of physical errors. No target fit, target-state parsing, covariance qualification or production change.
